   198	// DeleteShadowBranchesIfUnchanged deletes shadow branches only if each branch
   199	// still points at the hash observed by the caller. This avoids deleting a
   200	// branch that another session advanced after cleanup's initial scan.
   201	func DeleteShadowBranchesIfUnchanged(ctx context.Context, branches map[string]plumbing.Hash) (deleted []string, failed []string) {
   202		if len(branches) == 0 {
   203			return []string{}, []string{}
   204		}
   205		for branch, expected := range branches {
   206			if !IsShadowBranch(branch) || expected.IsZero() {
   207				failed = append(failed, branch)
   208				continue
   209			}
   210			protected, err := shadowBranchProtectedByCurrentState(ctx, branch)
   211			if err != nil {
   212				logging.Debug(ctx, "shadow branch unchanged-delete skipped after protection recheck failed",
   213					slog.String("branch", branch),
   214					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   215				)
   216				failed = append(failed, branch)
   217				continue
   218			}
   219			if protected {
   220				logging.Debug(ctx, "shadow branch unchanged-delete skipped because current session state protects it",
   221					slog.String("branch", branch),
   222				)
   223				failed = append(failed, branch)
   224				continue
   225			}
   226			ref := "refs/heads/" + branch
   227			cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "update-ref", "-d", ref, expected.String())
   228			if output, runErr := cmd.CombinedOutput(); runErr != nil {
   229				logging.Debug(ctx, "shadow branch unchanged-delete skipped",
   230					slog.String("branch", branch),
   231					slog.String("expected", expected.String()),
   232					slog.String("output", strings.TrimSpace(string(output))),
   233					slog.String("error", runErr.Error()),
   234				)
   235				failed = append(failed, branch)
   236				continue
   237			}
   238			deleted = append(deleted, branch)
   239		}
   240		return deleted, failed
   241	}

   123	// PromoteTmpRefSafely reads tmpRefName (the ref a fetch just landed into),

   125	// the tmp ref. The cleanup is deferred so the tmp ref is reaped even when

   133	func PromoteTmpRefSafely(ctx context.Context, tmpRefName, destRefName plumbing.ReferenceName, label string) error {
   134		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   135		if err != nil {
   136			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository for %s promote: %w", label, err)
   137		}
   138		defer repo.Close()

   141		tmpRef, err := repo.Reference(tmpRefName, true)
   142		if err != nil {
   143			return fmt.Errorf("%s not found after fetch (tmp ref %s missing): %w", label, tmpRefName, err)
   144		}

   151	// SafelyAdvanceLocalRef updates localRefName to include targetHash without

   154	// commits after the merge-base onto targetHash and move localRefName to the
   155	// replayed tip. If there is no merge-base and the reachable histories are
   156	// complete, the full local chain is replayed.
   157	func SafelyAdvanceLocalRef(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, localRefName plumbing.ReferenceName, targetHash plumbing.Hash) error {
   158		if _, err := checkpoint.ReadRefHash(repo, localRefName); err != nil {
   159			return fmt.Errorf("failed to read local ref %s: %w", localRefName, err)
   160		}
   161		repoPath, err := getRepoPath(repo)
   162		if err != nil {
   163			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo path: %w", err)
   164		}
   165		_, err = checkpoint.RunRefTransaction(ctx, repo, localRefName, func(localHash plumbing.Hash) (plumbing.Hash, bool, error) {
   166			if localHash.IsZero() {
   167				return targetHash, true, nil
   168			}
   169			if localHash == targetHash {
   170				return localHash, false, nil
   171			}
   172	
   173			mergeBase, mergeErr := getMergeBase(ctx, repoPath, localHash.String(), targetHash.String())
   174			if errors.Is(mergeErr, errNoMergeBase) {
   175				shallow, shallowErr := hasReachableShallowBoundary(ctx, repo, repoPath, localHash.String(), targetHash.String())
   176				if shallowErr != nil {
   177					return plumbing.ZeroHash, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to check shallow history for %s: %w", localRefName, shallowErr)
   178				}
   179				if shallow {
   180					return plumbing.ZeroHash, false, fmt.Errorf("no merge base for %s, and reachable shallow history prevents proving refs are disconnected; run 'entire doctor' or 'git fetch --unshallow' and try again", localRefName)

   184			if mergeErr != nil {
   185				return plumbing.ZeroHash, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to find merge base for %s: %w", localRefName, mergeErr)
   186			}
   187			if mergeBase == targetHash {

   189			}
   190			if mergeBase == localHash {
   191				return targetHash, true, nil
   192			}

   194		})

   197		}

   199	}

   228		//
   229		// A replay rewrites the local ref to the fetched remote tip with the local
   230		// commits re-applied on top: no checkpoint is lost, but the ref no longer
   231		// points where it did and the local commits have new hashes. That is the one
   232		// place a fetch reaches past remote-tracking refs into local state, so it must
   233		// leave a trace — the whole advance/replay chain was previously silent, which
   234		// made an invisible rewrite impossible to reconstruct afterwards from
   235		// .entire/logs/. Info rather than Debug: the default log level has to carry it
   236		// for a post-hoc investigation to find it.
   237		//
   238		// Metadata only (ref names, hashes, counts) per the logging privacy rule.
   239		logging.Info(ctx, "replaying local commits onto fetched tip; local ref will be rewritten",
   240			slog.String("reason", reason),
   241			slog.String("ref", localRefName.String()),
   242			slog.String("local_tip", localHash.String()),
   243			slog.String("target_tip", targetHash.String()),
   244			slog.Int("commits_replayed", len(localCommits)))

   285	func historyReachesShallowBoundary(ctx context.Context, repoPath, hash string, shallowCommits map[string]struct{}) (bool, error) {

   201	func DeleteShadowBranchesIfUnchanged(ctx context.Context, branches map[string]plumbing.Hash) (deleted []string, failed []string) {
   202		if len(branches) == 0 {
   203			return []string{}, []string{}
   204		}

   206			if !IsShadowBranch(branch) || expected.IsZero() {
   207				failed = append(failed, branch)

   209			}
   210			protected, err := shadowBranchProtectedByCurrentState(ctx, branch)

   213					slog.String("branch", branch),
   214					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   215				)
   216				failed = append(failed, branch)
   217				continue
   218			}
   219			if protected {
   220				logging.Debug(ctx, "shadow branch unchanged-delete skipped because current session state protects it",
   221					slog.String("branch", branch),
   222				)
   223				failed = append(failed, branch)

   232					slog.String("output", strings.TrimSpace(string(output))),
   233					slog.String("error", runErr.Error()),
   234				)

   237			}
   238			deleted = append(deleted, branch)

   166			if localHash.IsZero() {

   168			}
   169			if localHash == targetHash {
   170				return localHash, false, nil
   171			}
   172	
   173			mergeBase, mergeErr := getMergeBase(ctx, repoPath, localHash.String(), targetHash.String())
   174			if errors.Is(mergeErr, errNoMergeBase) {
   175				shallow, shallowErr := hasReachableShallowBoundary(ctx, repo, repoPath, localHash.String(), targetHash.String())

    53	// writeCheckpoint writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    54	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    55	// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    56	// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    57	// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    58	func (s *ephemeralStore) writeCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, opts WriteEphemeralOptions) (WriteEphemeralResult, error) {
    59		// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    60		if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    61			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    62		}
    63	
    64		// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    65		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    66			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Get shadow branch name
    70		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
    71	
    72		// Collect file lists once — the worktree state is stable across retries,
    73		// so this work doesn't repeat per CAS attempt. Tree-building (which
    74		// depends on the parent tree) is what re-runs inside the retry loop.
    75		var allFiles []string
    76		var allDeletedFiles []string
    77		if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    78			// For the first checkpoint, capture all changed files (modified tracked + untracked)
    79			// using `git status --porcelain -z` which respects both repo and global .gitignore.
    80			// This is much faster than filesystem walk. The base tree from HEAD already contains
    81			// all unchanged tracked files. We also capture user's pre-existing deletions.
    82			result, err := collectChangedFiles(ctx, s.repo)
    83			if err != nil {
    84				return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect changed files: %w", err)
    85			}
    86			allFiles = result.Changed
    87			// Merge user's pre-existing deletions with agent's deletions
    88			allDeletedFiles = result.Deleted
    89			allDeletedFiles = append(allDeletedFiles, opts.DeletedFiles...)
    90		} else {
    91			// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files.
    92			// Filter out gitignored files — agent transcripts may report files like .env
    93			// that exist on disk but are gitignored. Without filtering, secrets in gitignored
    94			// files would leak into the shadow branch and could be pushed to remotes.
    95			candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
    96			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
    97			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
    98			allFiles = filterGitIgnoredFiles(ctx, s.repo, candidateFiles)
    99			allDeletedFiles = opts.DeletedFiles
   100		}
   101	
   102		commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   103	
   104		commonDir, err := s.repoCommonDir(ctx)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve repo dirs: %w", err)
   107		}
   108	
   109		var result WriteEphemeralResult
   110		// withShadowBranchFlock serializes all writers targeting this shadow
   111		// branch — across goroutines and across processes — so the inner CAS
   112		// only sees contention from external `git update-ref` callers (rare).
   113		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   114			// Tiny CAS retry budget: with the flock held, races against our own
   115			// code are impossible. Retries cover the pathological case of an
   116			// external writer (a user invoking `git update-ref` manually, etc.).
   117			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   118				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)
   119				if gErr != nil {
   120					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", gErr)
   121				}
   122	
   123				// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
   124				var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
   125				if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   126					if lastCommit, lcErr := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); lcErr == nil {
   127						lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
   128					}
   129				}
   130	
   131				treeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, allDeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
   132				if tErr != nil {
   133					return fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", tErr)
   134				}
   135	
   136				// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the current shadow tip.
   137				if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
   138					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   139						CommitHash: parentHash,
   140						Skipped:    true,
   141					}
   142					return nil
   143				}
   144	
   145				commitHash, cErr := CreateCommit(ctx, s.repo, treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   146				if cErr != nil {
   147					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", cErr)
   148				}
   149	
   150				refErr := casUpdateShadowBranchRef(ctx, s.repo, shadowBranchName, commitHash, parentHash)
   151				if refErr == nil {
   152					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   153						CommitHash: commitHash,
   154						Skipped:    false,
   155					}
   156					return nil
   157				}
   158				if !errors.Is(refErr, ErrShadowRefBusy) {
   159					return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", refErr)
   160				}
   161				// Our commit is now dangling — best-effort remove it so we don't
   162				// leak loose objects across many losing attempts.
   163				tryDeleteLooseObject(commonDir, commitHash)
   164				if bErr := shadowRefBackoff(ctx, attempt); bErr != nil {
   165					return bErr
   166				}
   167			}
   168			// Retry budget exhausted. With the flock held this means an external
   169			// writer beat us shadowRefMaxRetries times in a row — surface it in
   170			// .entire/logs/ so operators can see a stuck shadow branch.
   171			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   172				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted",
   173				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   174				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   175			)
   176			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   177		})
   178		if err != nil {
   179			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, err
   180		}
   181		return result, nil
   182	}

    57	//   - Old format: entire/<commit[:7+]>

    64	// IsShadowBranch returns true if the branch name matches the shadow branch pattern.
    65	// Shadow branches have the format "entire/<commit-hash>-<worktree-hash>" where the
    66	// commit hash is at least 7 hex characters and worktree hash is 6 hex characters.

    72		}
    73		return shadowBranchPattern.MatchString(branchName)

  1523	// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
  1524	// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
  1525	// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
  1526	// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
  1527	func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
  1528		if content == "" {
  1529			return 0
  1530		}
  1531	
  1532		// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
  1533		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
  1534			session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
  1535			if err == nil && session != nil {
  1536				return len(session.Messages)
  1537			}
  1538			return 0
  1539		}
  1540	
  1541		// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
  1542		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
  1543			transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
  1544			if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
  1545				return len(transcript.Messages)
  1546			}
  1547			// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
  1548			if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
  1549				return 0
  1550			}
  1551			// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
  1552		}
  1553	
  1554		// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
  1555		allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
  1556		// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
  1557		for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
  1558			allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
  1559		}
  1560		return len(allLines)
  1561	}

  1563	// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
  1564	// Returns nil if content is empty.
  1565	func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
  1566		if content == "" {
  1567			return nil
  1568		}
  1569		parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")

  1574				result = append(result, trimmed)

  1651	// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
  1652	// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
  1653	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
  1654		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
  1655	
  1656		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
  1657		if err != nil {
  1658			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
  1659		}
  1660		defer repo.Close()
  1661	
  1662		var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
  1663		reserveErr := MutateSessionState(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1664			var reserveErr error
  1665			checkpointID, reserveErr = reserveDoctorCondensationAttempt(ctx, state)
  1666			return reserveErr
  1667		})
  1668		if errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1669			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
  1670		}
  1671		if reserveErr != nil {
  1672			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reserve checkpoint ID: %w", reserveErr)
  1673		}
  1674	
  1675		var shadowBranchName string
  1676		var clearAfter bool
  1677		var newSkillEvents []agent.SkillEvent
  1678		mutErr := MutateSessionStateOnSaved(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1679			if state.PendingCondensationID() != checkpointID {
  1680				return ErrMutationSkip
  1681			}
  1682	
  1683			shadowBranchName = getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1684			refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1685			_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1686			hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
  1687	
  1688			// Record-bearing sessions must materialize their records, not be cleared.
  1689			if !hasShadowBranch && !state.HasTaskContent() {
  1690				logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
  1691					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1692					slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1693				)
  1694				clearAfter = true
  1695				return ErrMutationSkip
  1696			}
  1697	
  1698			result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil, condenseOpts{reconcileInterrupted: true})
  1699			if err != nil {
  1700				return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
  1701			}
  1702			newSkillEvents = result.NewSkillEvents
  1703	
  1704			if result.Skipped {
  1705				logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensation skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
  1706					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1707				)
  1708				state.FullyCondensed = true
  1709				state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1710				return nil
  1711			}
  1712	
  1713			logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
  1714				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1715				slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
  1716				slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
  1717			)
  1718	
  1719			resetCheckpointWindow(state)
  1720			state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
  1721			state.CheckpointTranscriptSize = result.TranscriptSizeBaseline
  1722			state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
  1723			state.LastCheckpointID = result.CheckpointID
  1724			state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
  1725			state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
  1726			state.PromptAttributions = nil
  1727			state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
  1728			return nil
  1729		}, func() {
  1730			// Skill telemetry only. commitCondensedEmitter.emit is deliberately NOT
  1731			// called here: its payload is commit-scoped (files_committed counts a
  1732			// commit's files, and prior_ai_history's git-log probe uses --skip=1 to
  1733			// exclude the commit just made). This path condenses without a commit —
  1734			// doctor repairing an uncondensed session — so those fields would be
  1735			// meaningless and --skip=1 would exclude an unrelated HEAD. See

  1739		if errors.Is(mutErr, ErrStateNotFound) {

  1741		}

  1744		}

  1751		}

  1753		if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {

  1762	func prepareEagerCondensation(
  1763		logCtx context.Context,
  1764		repo *git.Repository,
  1765		state *SessionState,
  1766	) (shadowBranchName string, shouldCondense bool, err error) {
  1767		// Files waiting for a user commit belong to PostCommit's carry-forward path.
  1768		if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
  1769			return "", false, ErrMutationSkip
  1770		}
  1771		if !hasEagerCondensationContent(state) {
  1772			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1773			state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1774			return "", false, nil
  1775		}
  1776	
  1777		shadowBranchName = getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1778		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1779		if _, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true); refErr != nil && !state.HasTaskContent() {
  1780			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
  1781				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1782				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1783			)
  1784			state.StepCount = 0
  1785			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1786			state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1787			return shadowBranchName, false, nil
  1788		}
  1789	
  1790		return shadowBranchName, true, nil
  1791	}

  1793	// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
  1794	// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
  1795	// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
  1796	//
  1797	// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
  1798	// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
  1799	// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
  1800	// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
  1801	//
  1802	// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session remains eligible for a later
  1803	// retry with the same reserved checkpoint ID.
  1804	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
  1805		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
  1806	
  1807		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
  1808		if err != nil {
  1809			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
  1810				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1811				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1812			)
  1813			return nil
  1814		}
  1815		defer repo.Close()
  1816	
  1817		var shadowBranchName string
  1818		var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
  1819		reservedState, loadErr := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
  1820		if loadErr != nil {
  1821			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to load reserved checkpoint ID",
  1822				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1823				slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()),
  1824			)
  1825			return nil
  1826		}
  1827		if reservedState == nil {
  1828			return nil
  1829		}
  1830		if len(reservedState.FilesTouched) > 0 ||
  1831			(reservedState.FullyCondensed && !hasEagerCondensationContent(reservedState)) {
  1832			return nil
  1833		}
  1834		checkpointID = reservedState.PendingCondensationID()
  1835		shouldCondense := checkpointID != id.EmptyCheckpointID
  1836		if !shouldCondense {
  1837			reserveErr := MutateSessionState(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1838				var preflightErr error
  1839				shadowBranchName, shouldCondense, preflightErr = prepareEagerCondensation(logCtx, repo, state)
  1840				if preflightErr != nil || !shouldCondense {
  1841					return preflightErr
  1842				}
  1843				checkpointID, _, preflightErr = ensureCondensationAttemptID(logCtx, state)
  1844				return preflightErr
  1845			})
  1846			if errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrStateNotFound) || errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrMutationSkip) {
  1847				return nil
  1848			}
  1849			if reserveErr != nil {
  1850				logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to reserve checkpoint ID",
  1851					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1852					slog.String("error", reserveErr.Error()),
  1853				)
  1854				return nil
  1855			}
  1856		}
  1857		if !shouldCondense {
  1858			return nil
  1859		}
  1860	
  1861		var didCondense bool
  1862		var newSkillEvents []agent.SkillEvent
  1863		mutErr := MutateSessionStateOnSaved(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1864			var preflightErr error
  1865			shadowBranchName, shouldCondense, preflightErr = prepareEagerCondensation(logCtx, repo, state)
  1866			if preflightErr != nil || !shouldCondense {
  1867				return preflightErr
  1868			}
  1869	
  1870			checkpointID = state.PendingCondensationID()
  1871			if checkpointID == id.EmptyCheckpointID {
  1872				return ErrMutationSkip
  1873			}
  1874	
  1875			result, condErr := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil, condenseOpts{reconcileInterrupted: true})
  1876			if condErr != nil {
  1877				logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, doctor will retry",
  1878					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1879					slog.String("error", condErr.Error()),
  1880				)
  1881				return ErrMutationSkip // fail-open
  1882			}
  1883			newSkillEvents = result.NewSkillEvents
  1884	
  1885			if result.Skipped {
  1886				logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
  1887					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1888				)
  1889				state.FullyCondensed = true
  1890				state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1891				return nil
  1892			}
  1893	
  1894			resetCheckpointWindow(state)
  1895			state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
  1896			state.LastCheckpointID = result.CheckpointID
  1897			state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
  1898			state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
  1899			state.PromptAttributions = nil
  1900			state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
  1901			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1902			// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
  1903	
  1904			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
  1905				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1906				slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
  1907			)
  1908			didCondense = true
  1909			return nil
  1910		}, func() {
  1911			// Skill telemetry only — same reason as CondenseSessionByID: this
  1912			// condenses the work left over after the last commit, so there is no
  1913			// commit for the commit-condensed signal to describe.
  1914			EmitSkillInvocationTelemetry(ctx, newSkillEvents)
  1915		})
  1916		if errors.Is(mutErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1917			return nil
  1918		}
  1919		if mutErr != nil {
  1920			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", mutErr)
  1921		}
  1922	
  1923		if didCondense && shadowBranchName != "" {
  1924			if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
  1925				logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to clean up shadow branch",
  1926					slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1927					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1928				)
  1929			}
  1930		}
  1931		return nil
  1932	}

  1937		allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates(ctx)

   455			lastErr = err
   456		}
   457		return nil, "", lastErr
   458	}

   460	// sidecarSessionImages captures images an agent stores OUTSIDE the transcript
   461	// (e.g. Cursor's per-session SQLite blob store) as checkpoint assets, so they are
   462	// preserved with the session even though they never appear in full.jsonl. Unlike
   463	// externalizeSessionImages there is no transcript placeholder and no round trip:
   464	// these assets are preserve/view-only (the agent reads its own store on restore).
   465	//
   466	// Gated on the same opt-in flag. Best-effort: agents without the capability, or
   467	// any capture error, yield no assets (the checkpoint is written without them).
   468	func sidecarSessionImages(ctx, logCtx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, state *SessionState) []cpkg.TranscriptAsset {
   469		if !settings.IsImageExternalizationEnabled(ctx) {
   470			return nil
   471		}
   472		provider, ok := agent.AsSidecarImageProvider(ag)
   473		if !ok {
   474			return nil
   475		}
   476		assets, err := provider.SidecarImages(ctx, state.TranscriptPath)
   477		if err != nil {
   478			logging.Warn(logCtx, "sidecar image capture failed; checkpoint stored without them",
   479				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   480				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   481			return nil
   482		}
   483		if len(assets) == 0 {
   484			return nil
   485		}
   486		out := make([]cpkg.TranscriptAsset, len(assets))
   487		for i, a := range assets {
   488			out[i] = cpkg.TranscriptAsset{Name: a.Name, MediaType: a.MediaType, Data: a.Data}
   489		}
   490		return out
   491	}

   493	// checkpointStepCount returns the number of user prompts attributed to the
   494	// checkpoint being written: the turns counted since the current window's base.
   495	// The base is re-anchored (deferred) the next time a turn is counted after a
   496	// checkpoint write, so back-to-back checkpoints with no prompt between them share
   497	// a count. Floored at 1 so we never record 0 (covers a fast-path checkpoint
   498	// before any turn, and exec-mode gaps where turns weren't counted). Attach has
   499	// its own count (see attachStepCount); it does not go through this path.
   500	func checkpointStepCount(s *SessionState) int {
   501		if w := s.SessionTurnCount - s.PromptWindowBase; w >= 1 {
   502			return w
   503		}
   504		return 1
   505	}

   507	// CondenseSession condenses a session's shadow branch to permanent storage.
   508	// checkpointID is the 12-hex-char value from the Entire-Checkpoint trailer.
   509	// Metadata is stored at sharded path: <checkpoint_id[:2]>/<checkpoint_id[2:]>/
   510	// Uses checkpoint.PersistentStore.Write with a checkpoint.Session request for persistent storage.
   511	//
   512	// For mid-session commits (no Stop/SaveStep called yet), the shadow branch may not exist.
   513	// In this case, data is extracted from the live transcript instead.
   514	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSession(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, state *SessionState, committedFiles map[string]struct{}, opts ...condenseOpts) (*CondenseResult, error) {
   515		ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   516		var o condenseOpts
   517		if len(opts) > 0 {
   518			o = opts[0]
   519		}
   520		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
   521		condenseStart := time.Now()
   522		policy, err := readLocalCheckpointPolicy(logCtx, repo)
   523		if err != nil {
   524			return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkpoint policy could not be read: %w", err)
   525		}
   526		if !checkpointpolicy.CanSatisfyPolicy(policy) {
   527			warnIfCheckpointPolicyNeedsUpgrade(logCtx, policy)
   528			return nil, errors.New("checkpoint policy cannot be satisfied by this Entire CLI")
   529		}
   530	
   531		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   532		ref, hasShadowBranch := resolveShadowRef(repo, shadowBranchName, o.shadowRef)
   533	
   534		// Re-resolve transcript path before any reads — handles agents that relocate
   535		// transcripts mid-session (e.g., Cursor CLI flat → nested layout change).
   536		// Errors are ignored; downstream readers handle missing transcripts gracefully.
   537		resolveTranscriptPath(state) //nolint:errcheck,gosec // best-effort; downstream readers handle missing files
   538	
   539		extractStart := time.Now()
   540		_, extractSessionDataSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "extract_session_data")
   541		var shadowHash plumbing.Hash
   542		if hasShadowBranch {
   543			shadowHash = ref.Hash()
   544		}
   545		sessionData, extractErr := s.extractOrCreateSessionData(ctx, repo, ag, shadowHash, hasShadowBranch, state)
   546		if extractErr != nil {
   547			extractSessionDataSpan.RecordError(extractErr)
   548			extractSessionDataSpan.End()
   549			return nil, extractErr
   550		}
   551		extractSessionDataSpan.End()
   552		extractDuration := time.Since(extractStart)
   553	
   554		// Backfill session state token usage from the freshly-extracted transcript.
   555		// Copilot CLI writes session.shutdown after the hooks return, so by condensation
   556		// time we can recover the authoritative full-session total from the transcript
   557		// while keeping checkpoint metadata scoped to CheckpointTranscriptStart. The
   558		// recompute drops SubagentTokens (subagentsDir=""); the helper preserves the
   559		// cumulative subagent total across the backfill so resetCheckpointWindow's
   560		// baseline does not regress to nil (finding 019f5ebf-a57e).
   561		applyBackfilledSessionTokenUsage(ctx, ag, state, sessionData.Transcript, sessionData.TokenUsage)
   562	
   563		if !hasTokenUsageData(sessionData.TokenUsage) && hasTokenUsageData(state.CheckpointTokenUsage) {
   564			// Whole-value fallback: accumulateTokenUsage already carries SubagentTokens.
   565			sessionData.TokenUsage = accumulateTokenUsage(nil, state.CheckpointTokenUsage)
   566		} else {
   567			// Refill only the subagent total the recompute dropped. Runs after
   568			// applyBackfilledSessionTokenUsage, which needs the usage without it.
   569			sessionData.TokenUsage = withSubagentTokensFrom(sessionData.TokenUsage, state.CheckpointTokenUsage)
   570		}
   571	
   572		// Backfill the model from the transcript for agents that don't report it via
   573		// hooks (e.g., Pi records message.model but its hook events carry no model
   574		// field). Only fills when the model is otherwise unknown — hook-reported
   575		// models take precedence.
   576		if state.ModelName == "" {
   577			if model := sessionStateBackfillModel(ctx, ag, sessionData.Transcript); model != "" {
   578				state.ModelName = model
   579			}
   580		}
   581	
   582		if skipped := skipIfNothingToCondense(logCtx, sessionData, state, checkpointID, hasShadowBranch); skipped != nil {
   583			return skipped, nil
   584		}
   585	
   586		filterFilesTouched(sessionData, committedFiles, state)
   587	
   588		// sessionData.Transcript is left as the raw transcript; only the sanitized,
   589		// externalized, redacted copy is stored.
   590		externalizedTranscript, extractedAssets, transcriptSizeBaseline := prepareTranscriptForStorage(ctx, logCtx, ag, state, sessionData.Transcript)
   591	
   592		redactedTranscript, redactDuration := redactOrDrop(logCtx, repo, state.SessionID, externalizedTranscript, checkpointID)
   593		if skipped := skipIfPostRedactionEmpty(logCtx, redactedTranscript, sessionData, state, checkpointID); skipped != nil {
   594			return skipped, nil
   595		}
   596	
   597		// Telemetry-only search probe, computed exactly once for every result this
   598		// function can return (the recovery result below included) so no
   599		// construction site can ship the zero value by omission — the fabricated
   600		// negative searchProbe.measured exists to catch. Gated: the scan is a
   601		// full-transcript pass, and only the PostCommit path, with telemetry
   602		// enabled, has a reader for it. detectSearchUsage maps a nil agent or
   603		// empty transcript to unsupported, which is the honest answer for the
   604		// no-transcript extraction branch.
   605		if o.searchProbeAllowed != nil && o.searchProbeAllowed() {
   606			sessionData.SearchProbe = detectSearchUsage(ag, sessionData.Transcript)
   607		}
   608	
   609		// Capture agent sidecar images (e.g. Cursor's SQLite store) after the skip
   610		// check, so the sqlite3 shell-out is avoided when the checkpoint is discarded.
   611		extractedAssets = append(extractedAssets, sidecarSessionImages(ctx, logCtx, ag, state)...)
   612	
   613		// Materialize this session's subagent task records (#2058): every
   614		// completed-or-in-flight record's transcript is resolved, redacted, and
   615		// stored under this checkpoint's tasks/<tool-use-id>/ subtree.
   616		taskPayloads, extractedAssets := s.materializeTaskRecords(ctx, logCtx, ag, state, extractedAssets)
   617	
   618		store, err := s.getPersistentStore(ctx, repo)
   619		if err != nil {
   620			return nil, err
   621		}
   622		recovery := recoverInterruptedCondensation(
   623			ctx, logCtx,
   624			o.reconcileInterrupted && state.NeedsCondensationRecovery(),
   625			store, state, redactedTranscript, extractedAssets, sessionData, transcriptSizeBaseline,
   626		)
   627		if recovery.done {
   628			return recovery.result, recovery.err
   629		}
   630	
   631		writeOpts, attributionDuration, newSkillEvents := buildCondensationWriteOptions(
   632			ctx, repo, ref, state, sessionData, redactedTranscript, extractedAssets,
   633			taskPayloads, checkpointID, shadowBranchName, o,
   634		)
   635	
   636		writeV1Start := time.Now()
   637		writeCtx, writeCommittedSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "write_committed_v1")
   638		writeRequest := condensationSessionWriteRequest(writeOpts)
   639		if err := store.Write(writeCtx, writeRequest); err != nil {
   640			writeCommittedSpan.RecordError(err)
   641			writeCommittedSpan.End()
   642			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   643		}
   644		writeCommittedSpan.End()
   645		writeV1Duration := time.Since(writeV1Start)
   646	
   647		// Deferred prompt-window reset: a checkpoint was written, so the window base
   648		// must be re-anchored — but not now. We defer until the next counted turn (in
   649		// persistEventMetadataToState) so two checkpoints with no prompt between them
   650		// report the same count instead of the second showing 0.
   651		state.PromptWindowResetPending = true
   652	
   653		logging.Debug(logCtx, "condense timings",
   654			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   655			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   656			slog.Int64("extract_session_data_ms", extractDuration.Milliseconds()),
   657			slog.Int64("calculate_session_attribution_ms", attributionDuration.Milliseconds()),
   658			slog.Int64("redact_transcript_ms", redactDuration.Milliseconds()),
   659			slog.Int64("write_committed_v1_ms", writeV1Duration.Milliseconds()),
   660			slog.Int64("total_ms", time.Since(condenseStart).Milliseconds()),
   661			slog.Int("transcript_bytes", len(sessionData.Transcript)),
   662			slog.Int("transcript_lines", sessionData.FullTranscriptLines),
   663		)
   664	
   665		return &CondenseResult{
   666			CheckpointID:           checkpointID,
   667			SessionID:              state.SessionID,
   668			CheckpointsCount:       checkpointStepCount(state),
   669			FilesTouched:           sessionData.FilesTouched,
   670			Prompts:                sessionData.Prompts,
   671			TotalTranscriptLines:   sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   672			TranscriptSizeBaseline: transcriptSizeBaseline,
   673			NewSkillEvents:         newSkillEvents,
   674			SearchProbe:            sessionData.SearchProbe,
   675		}, nil
   676	}

   678	// condensationSessionWriteRequest returns the write request for one
   679	// condensation. Every condensation write is ReservedSession, unconditionally.
   680	//
   681	// The tempting refinement — send ReservedSession only when this session's own
   682	// pending attempt matches the checkpoint ID, and plain Session otherwise —
   683	// is wrong, and wrong in a worse direction than the problem it solves. A
   684	// checkpoint can hold several sessions, and only the one that reserved the ID
   685	// carries the reservation in its state. Routing per session would send the
   686	// reserving session's write to the backend the ID belongs to and every sibling's
   687	// write to the configured primary, splitting one checkpoint across both
   688	// backends. Reads are not symmetrical about that: a ULID resolves from git-refs
   689	// only, so the siblings written to the branch would simply be invisible. See
   690	// TestCondensationSessionWrites_KeepSharedReservedCheckpointInOneBackend.
   691	//
   692	// The cost of routing everything by ID format is narrow. It only diverges from
   693	// the configured primary when the ID's format disagrees with the primary, and
   694	// the two fail-soft defaults agree: GenerateCheckpointID mints hex when the
   695	// checkpoints config cannot be read, and resolvePrimaryType defaults to
   696	// git-branch on the same unreadable config. Reaching a mismatch on a *fresh* ID
   697	// therefore takes a config read that succeeds for one call and fails for the
   698	// other — and even then the checkpoint stays readable, because a hex ID under a
   699	// git-refs primary falls through to the branch on read.
   700	//
   701	// If the per-checkpoint routing decision ever does need to be conditional, it
   702	// has to be made once for the whole checkpoint (from the commit trailer or a
   703	// checkpoint-level flag), never per session.
   704	func condensationSessionWriteRequest(opts cpkg.WriteOptions) cpkg.WriteRequest {
   705		return cpkg.ReservedSession(opts)
   706	}

   708	func buildCondensationWriteOptions(
   709		ctx context.Context,
   710		repo *git.Repository,
   711		shadowRef *plumbing.Reference,
   712		state *SessionState,

   719		o condenseOpts,

   722		attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit

   725		}

   727		attributionStart := time.Now()

   730			headTree:              o.headTree,

   735			headCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
   736			allAgentFiles:         o.allAgentFiles,
   737		})
   738		attributionSpan.End()
   739		attributionDuration := time.Since(attributionStart)
   740	
   741		var summary *cpkg.Summary
   742		if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled(ctx) && transcript.Len() > 0 {
   743			summary = generateSummary(ctx, transcript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state)
   744		}
   745	
   746		// Post-commit emits regex-only blobs. OPF runs later in the
   747		// pre-push rewrite path, never here.
   748		newSkillEvents, skillEvents := persistNewSkillEvents(state, sessionData.SkillEvents)
   749		return cpkg.WriteOptions{

   753			Branch:                      GetCurrentBranchName(repo),
   754			Transcript:                  transcript,

   758			FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   759			CheckpointsCount:            checkpointStepCount(state),
   760			SaveStepCount:               state.StepCount,
  1500		data.Transcript = liveData
  1501		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
  1502		data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, state.SessionID)
  1503	
  1504		// Resolve files touched: prefers hook-populated state, falls back to transcript extraction
  1505		data.FilesTouched = s.resolveFilesTouched(ctx, state)
  1506	
  1507		// Calculate token usage from the checkpoint-scoped transcript portion.
  1508		// Skill events annotate the stored raw transcript, which is full-session, so
  1509		// extract them from offset 0; consumers can filter by checkpoint_transcript_start
  1510		// if they only render the checkpoint-scoped slice.
  1511		if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
  1512			// subagentsDir="" for the cost reason in extractSessionData above — but NOT
  1513			// for the cleanup reason: this is the live mid-turn path, where the subagent
  1514			// transcripts are still on disk. It is the one place the gap noted on
  1515			// withSubagentTokensFrom could be closed by reading them.
  1516			data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, "")
  1517			data.SkillEvents = agent.ExtractSkillEvents(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, 0)
  1518		}

  1520		return data, nil

  1522	
  1523	// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
  1524	// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
  1525	// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
  1526	// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
  1527	func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
  1528		if content == "" {
  1529			return 0
  1530		}
  1531	
  1532		// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
  1533		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
  1534			session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
  1535			if err == nil && session != nil {
  1536				return len(session.Messages)
  1537			}
  1538			return 0
  1539		}
  1540	
  1541		// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
  1542		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
  1543			transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
  1544			if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
  1545				return len(transcript.Messages)
  1546			}
  1547			// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
  1548			if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
  1549				return 0
  1550			}
  1551			// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
  1552		}
  1553	
  1554		// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
  1555		allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
  1556		// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
  1557		for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
  1558			allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
  1559		}
  1560		return len(allLines)
  1561	}
  1562	
  1563	// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
  1564	// Returns nil if content is empty.
  1565	func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
  1566		if content == "" {
  1567			return nil
  1568		}
  1569		parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")
  1570		var result []string
  1571		for _, p := range parts {
  1572			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p)
  1573			if trimmed != "" {
  1574				result = append(result, trimmed)
  1575			}
  1576		}
  1577		return result
  1578	}

  1582	// even for mid-turn commits where the shadow branch may not have been updated.

  1651	// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
  1652	// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
  1653	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
  1654		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
  1655	
  1656		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
  1657		if err != nil {
  1658			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
  1659		}
  1660		defer repo.Close()
  1661	
  1662		var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
  1663		reserveErr := MutateSessionState(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1664			var reserveErr error
  1665			checkpointID, reserveErr = reserveDoctorCondensationAttempt(ctx, state)
  1666			return reserveErr
  1667		})
  1668		if errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1669			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
  1670		}
  1671		if reserveErr != nil {
  1672			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reserve checkpoint ID: %w", reserveErr)
  1673		}
  1674	
  1675		var shadowBranchName string
  1676		var clearAfter bool

   678	// condensationSessionWriteRequest returns the write request for one
   679	// condensation. Every condensation write is ReservedSession, unconditionally.
   680	//
   681	// The tempting refinement — send ReservedSession only when this session's own
   682	// pending attempt matches the checkpoint ID, and plain Session otherwise —
   683	// is wrong, and wrong in a worse direction than the problem it solves. A
   684	// checkpoint can hold several sessions, and only the one that reserved the ID
   685	// carries the reservation in its state. Routing per session would send the
   686	// reserving session's write to the backend the ID belongs to and every sibling's
   687	// write to the configured primary, splitting one checkpoint across both
   688	// backends. Reads are not symmetrical about that: a ULID resolves from git-refs
   689	// only, so the siblings written to the branch would simply be invisible. See
   690	// TestCondensationSessionWrites_KeepSharedReservedCheckpointInOneBackend.
   691	//
   692	// The cost of routing everything by ID format is narrow. It only diverges from
   693	// the configured primary when the ID's format disagrees with the primary, and
   694	// the two fail-soft defaults agree: GenerateCheckpointID mints hex when the
   695	// checkpoints config cannot be read, and resolvePrimaryType defaults to
   696	// git-branch on the same unreadable config. Reaching a mismatch on a *fresh* ID
   697	// therefore takes a config read that succeeds for one call and fails for the
   698	// other — and even then the checkpoint stays readable, because a hex ID under a
   699	// git-refs primary falls through to the branch on read.
   700	//
   701	// If the per-checkpoint routing decision ever does need to be conditional, it
   702	// has to be made once for the whole checkpoint (from the commit trailer or a
   703	// checkpoint-level flag), never per session.
   704	func condensationSessionWriteRequest(opts cpkg.WriteOptions) cpkg.WriteRequest {
   705		return cpkg.ReservedSession(opts)
   706	}

   741		var summary *cpkg.Summary

   743			summary = generateSummary(ctx, transcript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state)
   744		}
   745	
   746		// Post-commit emits regex-only blobs. OPF runs later in the
   747		// pre-push rewrite path, never here.
   748		newSkillEvents, skillEvents := persistNewSkillEvents(state, sessionData.SkillEvents)
   749		return cpkg.WriteOptions{
   750			CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   751			SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   752			Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   753			Branch:                      GetCurrentBranchName(repo),

   760			SaveStepCount:               state.StepCount,
  1500		data.Transcript = liveData
  1501		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
  1502		data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, state.SessionID)

  1507		// Calculate token usage from the checkpoint-scoped transcript portion.
  1508		// Skill events annotate the stored raw transcript, which is full-session, so
  1509		// extract them from offset 0; consumers can filter by checkpoint_transcript_start
  1510		// if they only render the checkpoint-scoped slice.
  1511		if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
  1512			// subagentsDir="" for the cost reason in extractSessionData above — but NOT
  1513			// for the cleanup reason: this is the live mid-turn path, where the subagent
  1514			// transcripts are still on disk. It is the one place the gap noted on
  1515			// withSubagentTokensFrom could be closed by reading them.
  1516			data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, "")
  1517			data.SkillEvents = agent.ExtractSkillEvents(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, 0)

  1523	// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
  1524	// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
  1525	// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
  1526	// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
  1527	func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
  1528		if content == "" {
  1529			return 0
  1530		}
  1531	
  1532		// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
  1533		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
  1534			session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
  1535			if err == nil && session != nil {
  1536				return len(session.Messages)
  1537			}
  1538			return 0
  1539		}
  1540	
  1541		// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
  1542		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
  1543			transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
  1544			if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
  1545				return len(transcript.Messages)
  1546			}
  1547			// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
  1548			if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
  1549				return 0
  1550			}
  1551			// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
  1552		}
  1553	
  1554		// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
  1555		allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
  1556		// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
  1557		for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
  1558			allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
  1559		}
  1560		return len(allLines)
  1561	}

  1563	// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
  1564	// Returns nil if content is empty.
  1565	func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
  1566		if content == "" {
  1567			return nil
  1568		}
  1569		parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")
  1570		var result []string
  1571		for _, p := range parts {
  1572			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p)
  1573			if trimmed != "" {
  1574				result = append(result, trimmed)
  1575			}
  1576		}
  1577		return result
  1578	}

  1608	func ensureCondensationAttemptID(ctx context.Context, state *SessionState) (id.CheckpointID, bool, error) {

  1628		if state.Phase != session.PhaseEnded || len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {

  1651	// CondenseSessionByID condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
  1652	// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
  1653	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
  1654		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
  1655	
  1656		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
  1657		if err != nil {
  1658			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
  1659		}
  1660		defer repo.Close()
  1661	
  1662		var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
  1663		reserveErr := MutateSessionState(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1664			var reserveErr error
  1665			checkpointID, reserveErr = reserveDoctorCondensationAttempt(ctx, state)
  1666			return reserveErr
  1667		})
  1668		if errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1669			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
  1670		}
  1671		if reserveErr != nil {
  1672			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reserve checkpoint ID: %w", reserveErr)
  1673		}
  1674	
  1675		var shadowBranchName string
  1676		var clearAfter bool
  1677		var newSkillEvents []agent.SkillEvent
  1678		mutErr := MutateSessionStateOnSaved(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1679			if state.PendingCondensationID() != checkpointID {
  1680				return ErrMutationSkip
  1681			}
  1682	
  1683			shadowBranchName = getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1684			refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1685			_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1686			hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
  1687	
  1688			// Record-bearing sessions must materialize their records, not be cleared.
  1689			if !hasShadowBranch && !state.HasTaskContent() {
  1690				logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
  1691					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1692					slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1693				)
  1694				clearAfter = true
  1695				return ErrMutationSkip
  1696			}
  1697	
  1698			result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil, condenseOpts{reconcileInterrupted: true})
  1699			if err != nil {
  1700				return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
  1701			}
  1702			newSkillEvents = result.NewSkillEvents
  1703	
  1704			if result.Skipped {
  1705				logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensation skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
  1706					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1707				)
  1708				state.FullyCondensed = true
  1709				state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1710				return nil
  1711			}
  1712	
  1713			logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
  1714				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1715				slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
  1716				slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
  1717			)
  1718	
  1719			resetCheckpointWindow(state)
  1720			state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
  1721			state.CheckpointTranscriptSize = result.TranscriptSizeBaseline
  1722			state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
  1723			state.LastCheckpointID = result.CheckpointID
  1724			state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
  1725			state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
  1726			state.PromptAttributions = nil
  1727			state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
  1728			return nil
  1729		}, func() {
  1730			// Skill telemetry only. commitCondensedEmitter.emit is deliberately NOT
  1731			// called here: its payload is commit-scoped (files_committed counts a
  1732			// commit's files, and prior_ai_history's git-log probe uses --skip=1 to
  1733			// exclude the commit just made). This path condenses without a commit —
  1734			// doctor repairing an uncondensed session — so those fields would be
  1735			// meaningless and --skip=1 would exclude an unrelated HEAD. See
  1736			// newCommitCondensedSignal.
  1737			EmitSkillInvocationTelemetry(ctx, newSkillEvents)
  1738		})
  1739		if errors.Is(mutErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1740			return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
  1741		}
  1742		if mutErr != nil {
  1743			return mutErr
  1744		}
  1745	
  1746		if clearAfter {
  1747			if err := s.clearSessionState(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
  1748				return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
  1749			}
  1750			return nil
  1751		}
  1752	
  1753		if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
  1754			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
  1755				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1756				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1757			)
  1758		}
  1759		return nil
  1760	}

  1762	func prepareEagerCondensation(
  1763		logCtx context.Context,
  1764		repo *git.Repository,
  1765		state *SessionState,
  1766	) (shadowBranchName string, shouldCondense bool, err error) {
  1767		// Files waiting for a user commit belong to PostCommit's carry-forward path.
  1768		if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 {
  1769			return "", false, ErrMutationSkip
  1770		}
  1771		if !hasEagerCondensationContent(state) {
  1772			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1773			state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1774			return "", false, nil
  1775		}
  1776	
  1777		shadowBranchName = getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1778		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1779		if _, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true); refErr != nil && !state.HasTaskContent() {
  1780			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense: no shadow branch",
  1781				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1782				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
  1783			)
  1784			state.StepCount = 0
  1785			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1786			state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1787			return shadowBranchName, false, nil
  1788		}
  1789	
  1790		return shadowBranchName, true, nil
  1791	}

  1793	// CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed condenses an ENDED session and marks it
  1794	// FullyCondensed in one operation. Used by the session stop hook to eagerly
  1795	// clean up sessions so PostCommit doesn't have to process them.
  1796	//
  1797	// This does NOT call CondenseSessionByID because that method has two behaviors
  1798	// we don't want: (1) it calls clearSessionState when no shadow branch exists
  1799	// (deletes the state file entirely), and (2) it sets Phase = IDLE. Instead,
  1800	// we inline the condensation logic with ENDED-appropriate behavior.
  1801	//
  1802	// Fail-open: if condensation fails, the session remains eligible for a later
  1803	// retry with the same reserved checkpoint ID.
  1804	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
  1805		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
  1806	
  1807		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
  1808		if err != nil {
  1809			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to open repository",
  1810				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1811				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1812			)
  1813			return nil
  1814		}
  1815		defer repo.Close()
  1816	
  1817		var shadowBranchName string
  1818		var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
  1819		reservedState, loadErr := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
  1820		if loadErr != nil {
  1821			logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to load reserved checkpoint ID",
  1822				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1823				slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()),
  1824			)
  1825			return nil
  1826		}
  1827		if reservedState == nil {
  1828			return nil
  1829		}
  1830		if len(reservedState.FilesTouched) > 0 ||
  1831			(reservedState.FullyCondensed && !hasEagerCondensationContent(reservedState)) {
  1832			return nil
  1833		}
  1834		checkpointID = reservedState.PendingCondensationID()
  1835		shouldCondense := checkpointID != id.EmptyCheckpointID
  1836		if !shouldCondense {
  1837			reserveErr := MutateSessionState(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1838				var preflightErr error
  1839				shadowBranchName, shouldCondense, preflightErr = prepareEagerCondensation(logCtx, repo, state)
  1840				if preflightErr != nil || !shouldCondense {
  1841					return preflightErr
  1842				}
  1843				checkpointID, _, preflightErr = ensureCondensationAttemptID(logCtx, state)
  1844				return preflightErr
  1845			})
  1846			if errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrStateNotFound) || errors.Is(reserveErr, ErrMutationSkip) {
  1847				return nil
  1848			}
  1849			if reserveErr != nil {
  1850				logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense: failed to reserve checkpoint ID",
  1851					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1852					slog.String("error", reserveErr.Error()),
  1853				)
  1854				return nil
  1855			}
  1856		}
  1857		if !shouldCondense {
  1858			return nil
  1859		}
  1860	
  1861		var didCondense bool
  1862		var newSkillEvents []agent.SkillEvent
  1863		mutErr := MutateSessionStateOnSaved(ctx, sessionID, func(state *SessionState) error {
  1864			var preflightErr error
  1865			shadowBranchName, shouldCondense, preflightErr = prepareEagerCondensation(logCtx, repo, state)
  1866			if preflightErr != nil || !shouldCondense {
  1867				return preflightErr
  1868			}
  1869	
  1870			checkpointID = state.PendingCondensationID()
  1871			if checkpointID == id.EmptyCheckpointID {
  1872				return ErrMutationSkip
  1873			}
  1874	
  1875			result, condErr := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil, condenseOpts{reconcileInterrupted: true})
  1876			if condErr != nil {
  1877				logging.Warn(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop failed, doctor will retry",
  1878					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1879					slog.String("error", condErr.Error()),
  1880				)
  1881				return ErrMutationSkip // fail-open
  1882			}
  1883			newSkillEvents = result.NewSkillEvents
  1884	
  1885			if result.Skipped {
  1886				logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense skipped (no transcript or files), marking fully condensed",
  1887					slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1888				)
  1889				state.FullyCondensed = true
  1890				state.ClearCondensationAttempt()
  1891				return nil
  1892			}
  1893	
  1894			resetCheckpointWindow(state)
  1895			state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
  1896			state.LastCheckpointID = result.CheckpointID
  1897			state.LastCheckpointCommitHash = state.BaseCommit
  1898			state.RealignAttributionBase(state.BaseCommit)
  1899			state.PromptAttributions = nil
  1900			state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
  1901			state.FullyCondensed = true
  1902			// Phase stays ENDED — do NOT set to IDLE
  1903	
  1904			logging.Info(logCtx, "eager condense on session stop succeeded",
  1905				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
  1906				slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
  1907			)
  1908			didCondense = true
  1909			return nil
  1910		}, func() {
  1911			// Skill telemetry only — same reason as CondenseSessionByID: this
  1912			// condenses the work left over after the last commit, so there is no
  1913			// commit for the commit-condensed signal to describe.
  1914			EmitSkillInvocationTelemetry(ctx, newSkillEvents)
  1915		})
  1916		if errors.Is(mutErr, ErrStateNotFound) {
  1917			return nil
  1918		}
  1919		if mutErr != nil {
  1920			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", mutErr)

1	// Package checkpoint provides types and interfaces for checkpoint storage.
     2	//
     3	// A Checkpoint captures a point-in-time within a session, containing either
     4	// full state (Temporary) or metadata with a commit reference (Committed).
     5	//
     6	// See docs/architecture/sessions-and-checkpoints.md for the full domain model.
     7	package checkpoint
     8	
     9	import (
    10		"context"
    11		"time"
    12	
    13		"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/types"

    15		"github.com/go-git/go-git/v6/plumbing"
    16	)
    17	
    18	// Checkpoint represents a save point within a session.
    19	type Checkpoint struct {
    20		// ID is the unique checkpoint identifier
    21		ID string
    22	
    23		// SessionID is the session this checkpoint belongs to
    24		SessionID string
    25	
    26		// Timestamp is when this checkpoint was created
    27		Timestamp time.Time
    28	
    29		// Type indicates temporary (full state) or committed (metadata only)
    30		Type Type
    31	
    32		// Message is a human-readable description of the checkpoint
    33		Message string
    34	}
    35	
    36	// Type indicates the storage location and lifecycle of a checkpoint.
    37	type Type int
    38	
    39	const (
    40		// Ephemeral checkpoints contain full state (code + metadata) and are stored
    41		// on shadow branches (entire/<commit-hash>). Used for intra-session rewind.
    42		Ephemeral Type = iota
    43	
    44		// Persistent checkpoints contain metadata + commit reference and are stored
    45		// on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. They are the permanent record.
    46		Persistent
    47	)
    48	
    49	// EphemeralStore provides the production shadow-branch checkpoint surface.
    50	type EphemeralStore interface {
    51		Write(ctx context.Context, req EphemeralWriteRequest) (WriteEphemeralResult, error)
    52		Read(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadEphemeralResult, error)
    53		List(ctx context.Context) ([]EphemeralInfo, error)
    54		ListCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID, sessionID string, limit int) ([]EphemeralCheckpointInfo, error)
    55		ListCheckpointsForBranch(ctx context.Context, branchName, sessionID string, limit int) ([]EphemeralCheckpointInfo, error)
    56		ListAllCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, limit int) ([]EphemeralCheckpointInfo, error)
    57		GetTranscriptFromCommit(ctx context.Context, commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string, agentType types.AgentType) ([]byte, error)
    58		ShadowBranchExists(baseCommit, worktreeID string) bool
    59	}
    60	
    61	// WriteEphemeralResult contains the result of writing a temporary checkpoint.
    62	type WriteEphemeralResult struct {
    63		// CommitHash is the hash of the created or existing checkpoint commit
    64		CommitHash plumbing.Hash
    65	
    66		// Skipped is true if the checkpoint was skipped due to no changes
    67		// (tree hash matched the previous checkpoint)
    68		Skipped bool
    69	}
    70	
    71	// WriteEphemeralOptions contains options for writing a temporary checkpoint.
    72	type WriteEphemeralOptions struct {
    73		// SessionID is the session identifier
    74		SessionID string
    75	
    76		// BaseCommit is the commit hash this session is based on
    77		BaseCommit string
    78	
    79		// WorktreeID is the internal git worktree identifier (empty for main worktree)
    80		// Used to create worktree-specific shadow branch names
    81		WorktreeID string
    82	
    83		// ModifiedFiles are files that have been modified (relative paths)
    84		ModifiedFiles []string
    85	
    86		// NewFiles are files that have been created (relative paths)
    87		NewFiles []string
    88	
    89		// DeletedFiles are files that have been deleted (relative paths)
    90		DeletedFiles []string
    91	
    92		// MetadataDir is the relative path to the metadata directory
    93		MetadataDir string
    94	
    95		// MetadataDirAbs is the absolute path to the metadata directory
    96		MetadataDirAbs string
    97	
    98		// CommitMessage is the commit subject line
    99		CommitMessage string
   100	
   101		// AuthorName is the name to use for commits
   102		AuthorName string
   103	
   104		// AuthorEmail is the email to use for commits
   105		AuthorEmail string
   106	
   107		// IsFirstCheckpoint indicates if this is the first checkpoint of the session
   108		// When true, all working directory files are captured (not just modified)
   109		IsFirstCheckpoint bool
   110	}
   111	
   112	// ReadEphemeralResult contains the result of reading a temporary checkpoint.
   113	type ReadEphemeralResult struct {
   114		// CommitHash is the hash of the checkpoint commit
   115		CommitHash plumbing.Hash
   116	
   117		// TreeHash is the hash of the tree containing the checkpoint state
   118		TreeHash plumbing.Hash
   119	
   120		// SessionID is the session identifier from the commit trailer
   121		SessionID string
   122	
   123		// MetadataDir is the metadata directory path from the commit trailer
   124		MetadataDir string
   125	
   126		// Timestamp is when the checkpoint was created
   127		Timestamp time.Time
   128	}
   129	
   130	// EphemeralInfo contains summary information about a shadow branch.
   131	type EphemeralInfo struct {
   132		// BranchName is the full branch name (e.g., "entire/abc1234")
   133		BranchName string
   134	
   135		// BaseCommit is the short commit hash this branch is based on
   136		BaseCommit string
   137	
   138		// LatestCommit is the hash of the latest commit on the branch
   139		LatestCommit plumbing.Hash
   140	
   141		// SessionID is the session identifier from the latest commit
   142		SessionID string
   143	
   144		// Timestamp is when the latest checkpoint was created
   145		Timestamp time.Time
   146	}
   147	
   148	// Info provides summary information for listing checkpoints.
   149	// This is the generic checkpoint info type.
   150	type Info struct {
   151		// ID is the checkpoint identifier
   152		ID string
   153	
   154		// SessionID identifies the session
   155		SessionID string
   156	
   157		// Type indicates temporary or committed
   158		Type Type
   159	
   160		// CreatedAt is when the checkpoint was created
   161		CreatedAt time.Time
   162	
   163		// Message is a summary description
   164		Message string
   165	}
   166	
   167	// WriteEphemeralTaskOptions contains options for writing a task checkpoint.
   168	// Task checkpoints are created when a subagent completes and contain both
   169	// code changes and task-specific metadata.
   170	type WriteEphemeralTaskOptions struct {
   171		// SessionID is the session identifier
   172		SessionID string
   173	
   174		// BaseCommit is the commit hash this session is based on
   175		BaseCommit string
   176	
   177		// WorktreeID is the internal git worktree identifier (empty for main worktree)
   178		// Used to create worktree-specific shadow branch names
   179		WorktreeID string
   180	
   181		// ToolUseID is the unique identifier for this Task tool invocation
   182		ToolUseID string
   183	
   184		// AgentID is the subagent identifier
   185		AgentID string
   186	
   187		// Agent identifies the agent that spawned the subagent. Needed to sanitize the
   188		// stored subagent transcript: the type cannot be recovered from content, since
   189		// DetectAgentTypeFromContent only recognizes Gemini.
   190		Agent types.AgentType
   191	
   192		// ModifiedFiles are files that have been modified (relative paths)
   193		ModifiedFiles []string
   194	
   195		// NewFiles are files that have been created (relative paths)
   196		NewFiles []string
   197	
   198		// DeletedFiles are files that have been deleted (relative paths)
   199		DeletedFiles []string
   200	
   201		// TranscriptPath is the path to the main session transcript
   202		TranscriptPath string
   203	
   204		// SubagentTranscriptPath is the path to the subagent's transcript
   205		SubagentTranscriptPath string
   206	
   207		// CheckpointUUID is the UUID for transcript truncation when rewinding
   208		CheckpointUUID string
   209	
   210		// CommitMessage is the commit message (already formatted)
   211		CommitMessage string
   212	
   213		// AuthorName is the name to use for commits
   214		AuthorName string
   215	
   216		// AuthorEmail is the email to use for commits
   217		AuthorEmail string
   218	
   219		// IsIncremental indicates this is an incremental checkpoint
   220		IsIncremental bool
   221	
   222		// IncrementalSequence is the checkpoint sequence number
   223		IncrementalSequence int
   224	
   225		// IncrementalType is the tool that triggered this checkpoint
   226		IncrementalType string
   227	
   228		// IncrementalData is the tool_input payload for this checkpoint
   229		IncrementalData []byte
   230	}
   231	
   232	// EphemeralCheckpointInfo contains information about a single commit on a shadow branch.
   233	// Used by ListCheckpoints to provide rewind point data.
   234	type EphemeralCheckpointInfo struct {
   235		// CommitHash is the hash of the checkpoint commit
   236		CommitHash plumbing.Hash

   238		// Message is the first line of the commit message
   239		Message string

   242		SessionID string

   245		MetadataDir string

   248		IsTaskCheckpoint bool

   250		// ToolUseID is the tool use ID for task checkpoints
   251		ToolUseID string
   252	
   253		// Timestamp is when the checkpoint was created
   254		Timestamp time.Time
   255	}

   396	func recomputeSummary(sc *storedCheckpoint) {
   397		summary := &sc.Summary
   398		summary.Sessions = make([]cp.SessionFilePaths, len(sc.Sessions))
   399		summary.CheckpointsCount = 0
   400		summary.TokenUsage = nil
   401		files := map[string]struct{}{}
   402	
   403		for i := range sc.Sessions {
   404			summary.Sessions[i] = cp.SessionFilePaths{
   405				Metadata:   fmt.Sprintf("%d/metadata.json", i+1),
   406				Transcript: fmt.Sprintf("%d/full.jsonl", i+1),
   407				Prompt:     fmt.Sprintf("%d/prompt.txt", i+1),
   408			}
   409		}
   410	
   411		ordered := make([]*storedSession, len(sc.Sessions))
   412		for i := range sc.Sessions {
   413			ordered[i] = &sc.Sessions[i]
   414		}
   415		sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i].SessionID < ordered[j].SessionID })
   416		for _, session := range ordered {

   418			summary.Strategy = metadata.Strategy

   422			}
   423			summary.CheckpointsCount += metadata.CheckpointsCount

   426			summary.HasInvestigation = summary.HasInvestigation || metadata.Kind == checkpointKindAgentInvestigate

   433		for f := range files {

   112	func withShadowBranchFlocks(commonDir string, branchNames []string, fn func() error) error {
   113		ordered := append([]string(nil), branchNames...)
   114		sort.Strings(ordered)
   115		unique := ordered[:0]
   116		for _, branchName := range ordered {

   122		releases := make([]func(), 0, len(unique))

   137			}
